## Why This Is Asked
This probes multi-tenant KCA with rapid rotation, OTA integrity, and cross-region trust, all under practical campus-scale constraints.

- Hardware root attestation and regional bootstrap
- Per-device SPIFFE IDs and ai-edge scope

- PQC fallback and revocation/audit

```javascript
function provisionCertificate(device, region, tenant) {

  const cert = centralKCA.signCSR({csr, subject: `spiffe://${tenant}/ai-edge/${device}`, ttl: 900});
  store(cert, OTAKey);
}
```

- In-app device attestation and platform trust

- Short-lived certificates and renewal triggers
- Streaming policies to devices
- Online and offline revocation handling

```javascript
function enroll(device) {
  const attestation = attestDevice(device); // platform attestation
  const spiffeId = `spiffe://tenant/${device.tenantId}/device/${device.id}`;
  return kca.enroll(attestation, spiffeId);
}
```
